own_review.changed: none applied: plan mode was active in this session, which blocks every edit except the plan file. I didn't touch WP-20.md. The full replacement text for WP-20.md is in roadmap-v2-findings/WP-20-proposal.md, ready to copy over. It makes these changes: (1) The signatures now match WP-01.md:171-177. UnitSpec keeps 3 fields {exec_start, start_limit_interval_sec, start_limit_burst}, and Description, RestartSec and WantedBy are fixed text. execute and execute_uninstall take a third argument, &EnginePaths, which is unused. They return install::InstallReport{steps}, not api::InstallReport, with a stated mapping in case WP-01 switches to the api type. (2) WP-20 adds the derives itself (Serialize on InstallReport, Default impl on UnitSpec) and makes its helpers private, per the glob guard. (3) Uninstall now only removes files under ~/.local/bin, ~/.local/share/flat3d and ~/.config/systemd/user, and refuses paths containing '..'. The old rule allowed anything under ~/.local/, which includes ~/.local/state and broke the keep-state rule. (4) Install creates each tree's destination dir, which `dirs` didn't cover. (5) add_wrapper_at falls back to the bare form when the last segment of the absolute path isn't flat3d-run, so remove_wrapper can still find it. (6) Test inputs and expected outputs are now concrete: temp layout, the Fake runner's behaviour, EnginePaths built with the §2 frozen from_env(BTreeMap) form, the exact locked PAIRS for the inverse test, and the fallback cases. (7) Fixed a stale line reference: is_wrapper is at launch_options.rs:51-53, not 142-144. (8) Removed the stale flag claiming WP-08 is in the same wave; WP-08 is wave 3. Added a 'Wave: 2' line, a 'no network or device' note, and clippy, fmt and Cargo.lock checks to the done-check. Wave 2 is correct: the only dependency is WP-01 (wave 1), and no other wave-2 WP owns install.rs, launch_options.rs or packaging/flat3d-link.service.
